sections.heading: The Carry-Away Box That Doubles as Branding
sections.text: House-Shaped Carry Box The Carry-Away Box That Doubles as Branding The gable box — named for its house-roof shape — gives a small gift or treat an instant carry handle and a friendly, premium silhouette. Because it ships and stores flat, then snaps together in seconds, it is a favourite for bakeries, party planners and gift-set brands that need volume without storage headaches. We produce gable boxes in coated cardstock, natural kraft or corrugated board depending on weight and use, with a die-cut integrated handle that holds securely. Print full-bleed inside and out, add a window patch to show the product, or specify food-grade coatings for direct-contact bakery and food use. From mini favor gables to large hamper-size carriers, every box is custom-sized to your product, with matching tissue, stickers and ribbon available for a complete set.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions What is a gable box? A gable box is a house-shaped (roof-top) box with a built-in die-cut carry handle. It ships flat and snaps together quickly, making it a popular, practical format for bakery, party favors, hampers and gift sets. Are gable boxes food-safe? Yes. We offer food-safe coatings and liners for direct-contact use with pastries, cookies, cupcakes and other bakery and food items. Can gable boxes have a window? Yes. We add a die-cut window with a clear PET patch so customers can see the product before opening — popular for bakery and gift treats. What is the MOQ for custom gable boxes? Standard MOQ is 300 pcs for a custom size with full printing. Higher volumes reduce the per-unit cost significantly. What sizes are available? Fully custom — from mini favor gables (around 12×9×9cm) to hamper-size carriers (around 26×18×20cm) sized to your product.
